title: Accounts Assistant
description:

- Manage the whole sales/purchase ledger department and maintain accurate supplier accounts
- Respond to all supplier and customer queries within finance

- Assisting with payroll queries and administration

title: Finance Assistant
description:
As a Finance Assistant in the healthcare industry, based in Chester, you'll play a key role in supporting the day-to-day financial operations of the organisation. From managing invoices to assisting with reconciliations, your work will help ensure the smooth running of the accounting and finance department.

Client Details

This role is with a company in the healthcare industry located in Chester.

Description
- Process invoices, payments, and expense claims accurately and efficiently.
- Assist with bank reconciliations and maintaining financial records.
- Support the preparation of financial reports and statements.
- Maintain the accuracy of accounting ledgers and resolve discrepancies.
- Collaborate with other departments to ensure timely financial data collection.
- Provide administrative support to the accounting and finance team.
- Respond to queries related to financial transactions and records.
- Contribute to the implementation of process improvements within the finance function.

Profile

A successful Finance Assistant should have:
- Previous experience in a finance or accounting role.
- Familiarity with financial systems and software.
- Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to prioritise tasks effectively.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other relevant tools.
- A collaborative approach and a willingness to support team goals.

Job Offer
- Competitive salary ranging from £26,200 to £30,800, dependent on the level of experience.
- Permanent position in the healthcare industry.
- Opportunity to work in Chester in a finance-focused role.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
company: Adele Carr Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts Payable Clerk

Salary
£30,000 - £35,000 per annum

Location
Winsford, Cheshire

Working Hours
Full-time, 40 hours per week
Monday to Thursday: 7:30am - 4:00pm
Friday: 7:30am - 1:30pm

Benefits
- Salary of £30,000 - £35,000
- 4% employer pension contribution
- Early finish every Friday
- Permanent, full-time position
- Opportunity to join a growing finance function
- Varied role with exposure beyond traditional Purchase Ledger duties

About the Role

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced Accounts Payable / Finance Administrator to join a busy finance team based in Winsford.

This is a varied position that would suit someone with a strong background in Accounts Payable / Purchase Ledger who enjoys taking ownership of their workload and working across multiple company ledgers.

You will be responsible for the accurate and timely processing of financial transactions, working closely with both Finance and Procurement. Alongside day-to-day Accounts Payable duties, you will also gain exposure to month-end, audit support, process improvements and wider finance administration.

Key Responsibilities
- Process purchase invoices and credit notes accurately and within agreed timescales.
- Support the Purchase Ledger function across two group companies.
- Match purchase orders, delivery notes and goods received documentation.
- Check nominal codes and ensure transactions are correctly recorded.
- Liaise with Procurement regarding purchase orders, goods received and planned deliveries.
- Complete supplier statement reconciliations and investigate discrepancies.
- Liaise directly with suppliers to resolve invoice and account queries.
- Ensure appropriate VAT treatment when processing transactions.
- Collate, code and process company credit card expenditure.
- Maintain accurate electronic finance records and filing systems.
- Support the Finance team with month-end preparation.
- Provide supporting information for audit requirements.
- Assist with writing and developing internal finance procedures and SOPs.
- Provide additional finance and administration support as required.

Skills & Experience

To be considered for this opportunity, you will ideally have:
- A minimum of two years' Accounts Payable / Purchase Ledger experience.
- Strong Purchase Ledger processing experience.
- Previous experience working across multiple companies or ledgers.
- A good understanding of VAT within Accounts Payable.
- Experience using accounting software.
- Good Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.
- Excellent attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
- Strong organisational and administrative skills.
- Confidence communicating with suppliers and internal departments.
- The ability to manage deadlines and prioritise a varied workload.
- A reliable, enthusiastic and professional approach.

What's in it for you?

This is a great opportunity for an experienced Accounts Payable professional looking for their next permanent role in the Winsford area.

You'll receive a salary of £30,000 - £35,000, alongside a 4% employer pension contribution and an attractive working week with a 1:30pm finish every Friday.

You'll also have the opportunity to broaden your experience beyond traditional Purchase Ledger, gaining exposure to month-end, audit support and finance process improvements within a growing business.

Apply Now

If you have strong Accounts Payable, Purchase Ledger or Finance Administration experience and are looking for a new opportunity in Winsford, we'd be keen to hear from you.

title: Sales Ledger Administrator
description:

Role Responsibilities
- Manage the sales ledger administration process, ensuring customer accounts and transactions are processed accurately and efficiently
- Raise and process customer invoices accurately and in a timely manner

- Check sales orders and supporting information to ensure all details are accurate before invoicing
- Maintain accurate sales ledger and customer records within the company system
- Work closely with the accounts team to ensure sales orders, invoices and related records are kept up to date.
- Investigate and resolve any discrepancies between sales orders, goods dispatched and invoices
